correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated the 4096 edge subsets and 44 forbidden disjoint triples. Verified 601 augmented faces, 295 ordinary Morse pairs and exactly one critical vertex and nine critical 3-cells. Traversed the entire oriented ordinary Hasse graph by depth-first cycle detection on 600 faces. Hence the ordinary Morse CW model implies the integral wedge and supports degree-three concentration. Recomputed Lefschetz traces by summing over unions of edge-permutation cycles rather than by scanning signed stable faces; the contribution is minus one to the power of the number of cycles selected. Compared with the proposed character on each of the 48 elements, obtaining identical character values and hence the same rational module. The antipodal case has counts (1,6,12,4), trace 3, and multiplicities 6 and 3 by rank and involutivity. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/audit_cube.py.
residual_risks: The reduced integral homotopy type is nonequivariant; the character argument determines a rational module only, not the integral module or cell-level equivariant type.

evidence: Edge addition gives top-degree injection and a cycle gives nonvanishing. The complete-bipartite tensor theorem is equivariant under S4×S4 for this size. The link-vanishing theorem is not a character theorem.
